description: How Sydney is commuting since COVID, from TfNSW Opal tap data (Commute Pulse). 'friday_gap' = Friday evening tap-ons as a share of Tue-Thu, monthly since 2020 - the core return-to-office measure (1.0 = no gap). Also: 'monday_gap', 'evening_volume' (Tue-Thu evening tap-ons per day), 'baseline' (pre-COVID ratios), 'cbd_hourly' (CBD tap-ons by hour, pre-COVID vs last 12 months), 'suburban_morning' (Friday vs midweek 7-9am outside the centres).

end.description: Latest period, YYYY-MM. Omit for up to the latest release.

start.description: Earliest period, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2022-01). Omit for the full history.

name: get_commute_pulse
